descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Pink Panther' Pink Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Pink Panther' bursts into bright pink foliage in early spring. As the season progresses, its vibrant hue mellows to a crisp olive green, complemented by coral pink new growth in summer. Come autumn, expect a stunning display of orange to red foliage. Distinguished by its larger, more amoenum-like leaves compared to other spring-interest trees, 'Pink Panther' reaches heights of 8-10 ft over 10 years. Developed by the Mendoza family, this variety is a fresh addition to the botanical scene.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Pink Panther'，粉叶日本枫，适生区 5-9。 ‘Pink Panther’ 在早春萌发出亮粉色叶片。 随着季节推进，这种鲜艳色调会逐渐转为清新的橄榄绿色，夏季新生叶则带有珊瑚粉色。 秋季可呈现橙至红色的绚丽叶色。 与其他以春色见长的品种相比，‘Pink Panther’ 叶片更大，更接近 amoenum 类型叶形。 10 年可长至 8-10 英尺。 该品种由 Mendoza 家族培育，是植物界的新近引入品种。
